paragraphs.text: DSH 插件：给每条会话标题加上所属项目名前缀
DSH 插件：**给每条会话标题加上所属项目名前缀**。
DSH plugin: **prefixes every session title with the name of its workspace / project.**
兜底标题和模型生成的标题都会加前缀；你手动改过的标题不加。
适合**会话列表单列平铺展示**时使用：不必点开每条会话，就能看出它属于哪个 workspace / 项目。
Both fallback titles and model-generated titles get the prefix; titles you renamed yourself are left
ck titles and model-generated titles get the prefix; titles you renamed yourself are left unchanged.
Useful when the **session list is a single flat column**: you can tell which workspace / project eac
h conversation belongs to without opening it.
